/*
	NGUYỄN VĂN VIỆT	23/8/18
	Tra cứu hồ sơ tuyển sinh online 
*/

ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[SIM_StudentCollection_SearchForWeb]
(	
    @StudentCollectionCode NVARCHAR(50) = Null,	
	@FullNameEn varchar(200) = null    
)
AS
BEGIN

	if isnull(@FullNameEn,'') = '' set @FullNameEn = null
	else set @FullNameEn = '%' + @FullNameEn + '%' 

	SELECT        		
		tbl.[StudentCollectionCode],
		tbl.[StudentFirstName],
		tbl.[StudentLastName],
		tbl.[StudentFirstName] + ' ' + tbl.[StudentLastName] as StudentName,		
		tbl.[BirthDateText],		
        Case when tbl.[Gender] = 1 then 'Nam' else N'Nữ' End as [GenderText],								
		tbl.BirthPlace,		
		tbl.LiveAddress,
				
		SIM_StudentCollectionPeriod.StudentCollectionPeriodName,
		case when tbl.Result > 0 then tblSpecialBranchOk.SpecialBranchName else '' end as "SpecialBranchNameOk", 
		case when tbl.Result > 0 then N'Đã trúng tuyển' else '' end "ResultText"
		
		
	FROM [SIM_StudentCollection] tbl
			INNER join 	SIM_StudentCollectionPeriod on SIM_StudentCollectionPeriod.StudentCollectionPeriodID = tbl.StudentCollectionPeriodID			
			Left join 	SIM_SpecialBranch tblSpecialBranchOk on tblSpecialBranchOk.SpecialBranchID = tbl.SpecialBranchIDOk					
			
	WHERE (tbl.[IsDeleted] = 0)
		and (@StudentCollectionCode = '' or tbl.StudentCollectionCode = @StudentCollectionCode)
		and (@FullNameEn is null or tbl.StudentFirstName + ' ' + tbl.StudentLastName like @FullNameEn)
		and (@FullNameEn is null or tbl.FullnameEn like @FullNameEn)
		
	Order By tbl.StudentCollectionCode, tbl.[StudentLastName],tbl.[StudentFirstName]
	
END
